data.title: Who Really Owns the Bitcoin Inside BlackRock’s ETF?
data.description: Millions of investors hold IBIT shares believing they have exposure to Bitcoin, but the actual ownership chain running through a Delaware trust, a crypto custodian, and a handful of authorized traders tells a more complicated story.
